note: Typed declaration of the SP-94 acceptance criteria whose ground truth requires a named non-production HA environment plus load/fault/alert authority, and of the NEGATIVE CONTROL that proves the only startable local stack cannot substitute for it. scripts/qualify_barbarossa_ha_v1.py joins this matrix with Barbarossa's own committed deploy/config/management-readonly-local/topology.json, so a claim here that the owner does not actually make fails the qualifier closed.

negative_control.why_it_is_a_negative_control: The management-readonly-local-v1 Docker stack is the only Barbarossa runtime that can be started here. Its OWN committed topology declares it non-HA. It is used ONLY as proof that AC-SP94-2/3/4/5 cannot be qualified in this environment; it is never presented as HA evidence.

environment_gated_criteria.requirement: Distributed work preserves one authoritative history across duplicate and worker-crash boundaries
required_inputs: externally injected work-broker delivery trace from a replicated (R3) JetStream cluster
owner-store transaction history from a replicated PostgreSQL cluster with an induced failover
outbox publication trace correlated to that delivery trace
the final signed authoritative receipt set for every duplicate, crash-before-commit and crash-after-commit-before-ACK case
a named non-production environment receipt authorizing worker-crash injection
forbidden_substitutes: Barbarossa's in-process logic doubles (internal/work/*_test.go) presented as live delivery evidence
a hand-written fixture describing what the trace would have contained

environment_gated_criteria.requirement: Fencing ordering retries and quarantine remain safe under concurrency and partitions
required_inputs: a controlled lease-partition and delivery-reorder timeline produced by an external fault controller
fencing and store rows captured from the owner store across that timeline
broker state (stream, consumer, pending, redelivery) captured independently of the owner process
the owner projection observed before and after each partition and poison event
a named non-production environment receipt authorizing partition injection
forbidden_substitutes: the single-host management-readonly-local-v1 stack, which cannot be partitioned
Barbarossa's deterministic ordering/fencing conformance fixtures presented as a live partition timeline
any automatic DLQ redrive performed to make quarantine look bounded

environment_gated_criteria.requirement: Selected service and work SLOs survive declared replica broker store and failure-domain faults
required_inputs: at least three declared failure domains with the SP-92 rendered topology actually scheduled across them
independent request and work generators outside the owner process
a fault-controller timeline for pod loss, broker-node loss, store failover, zone loss and recovery
external SLO observations (availability, latency, recovery interval, integrity) not derived from the owner's own metrics
quorum state captured from the broker and store clusters
a named non-production environment receipt authorizing failure-domain loss
forbidden_substitutes: the single-host management-readonly-local-v1 stack (failure_domain_quorum and failover are not_qualified)
deploy/ha/*.json replica counts and PodDisruptionBudgets read as attained availability
the owner's own declared capacity envelope read as a measured SLO result

environment_gated_criteria.requirement: Capacity autoscaling drain rollout and rollback remain stable under sustained burst and soak load
required_inputs: an immutable load model plus an external load-generation authority
autoscaler events from a live horizontal autoscaler driven by queue lag and oldest work age
queue and store metrics captured across sustained, burst and soak windows
scheduler events and process traces for scale-in, rolling upgrade and graceful drain
a post-rollback conformance capture against the exact prior known-good release
a named non-production environment receipt authorizing load generation and rollout
forbidden_substitutes: the single-host management-readonly-local-v1 stack (autoscaling and failover are not_qualified)
deploy/ha/capacity-envelope.json declared targets read as attained throughput
deploy/ha/worker-hpa.json thresholds read as observed autoscaler decisions

environment_gated_criteria.requirement: Qualification is observable reproducible reversible and non-authorizing
required_inputs: an independent alert-observer receipt showing deploy/ha/alerts.json rules actually evaluating and firing against seeded failures
an evidence-manifest signing authority and the signature over the emitted manifest
a named non-production environment receipt with owner, identity, allowed faults and rollback target
a post-rollback inventory captured from that environment after the exact declared rollback was executed
prior known-good release digests plus a backup/restore target
forbidden_substitutes: deploy/ha/alerts.json rule definitions read as alert evaluations
docs/runbooks/high-availability.md read as an executed rollback
this qualifier's own unsigned evidence manifest read as a signed attestation
